01 · About Me

From learning to building.

A focused portfolio built around practical learning, honest experience, and work that shows how I approach technical problems.

I’m Ahmed Mohamed, an AI & Machine Learning practitioner focused on Python, data analysis, visualization, and practical machine-learning solutions. I approach every project with a clear objective: understand the problem, work carefully with the data, build an appropriate solution, and turn the result into something useful and easy to understand.

My work combines analytical thinking with hands-on implementation across data preparation, exploratory analysis, visualization, clustering, regression, and model evaluation. I value clean workflows, clear documentation, and solutions that are practical rather than unnecessarily complicated.

My USP · Value Proposition
I help individuals and small businesses explore their data through clear Python-based analysis and practical machine-learning prototypes, with a focus on understandable results and well-documented work.

Machine Learning · Clustering

Customer Segmentation using K-Means

A practical customer-segmentation workflow that transforms customer attributes into meaningful groups using K-Means clustering.

PythonPandasNumPyScikit-learnMatplotlibK-Means

The Challenge

Identify natural customer groups without predefined labels, so patterns in customer behavior can be understood and communicated clearly.

Approach

  • Inspected the dataset and its main features.
  • Prepared the numerical features for clustering.
  • Scaled relevant variables so features contribute on a comparable basis.
  • Used the Elbow Method to choose a practical number of clusters.
  • Applied K-Means and analyzed the resulting customer groups.
  • Visualized and documented the segmentation workflow.

Data Analysis · Visualization

Sales Data Analysis

An exploratory sales-analysis workflow focused on revenue, orders, customers, average order value, and clear visual communication.

PythonPandasNumPyMatplotlibJupyter

The Challenge

Turn raw sales records into understandable performance indicators and visual insights that make important patterns easier to see.

Approach

  • Loaded and inspected the sales dataset.
  • Prepared records for analysis and grouped them by useful business dimensions.
  • Calculated revenue, order counts, customer counts, and average order value.
  • Explored changes over time and compared key metrics.
  • Created visualizations to communicate the main findings.
  • Documented the analysis in a reproducible notebook.

Machine Learning · Regression

House Price Prediction

A regression workflow for predicting house prices from structured features and evaluating model performance on unseen data.

PythonPandasNumPyScikit-learnLinear RegressionMAERMSER²

The Challenge

Build a simple and interpretable baseline for estimating house prices, then evaluate the quality of its predictions using standard regression metrics.

Approach

  • Inspected the housing features and target variable.
  • Prepared the data for supervised learning.
  • Split the data into training and testing sets.
  • Trained a Linear Regression model.
  • Generated predictions for the test set.
  • Evaluated the model using MAE, RMSE, and R².
